evidence: Reading down the centre column: the chimney (rows 8-20) leads into a sloped range hood (rows 21-26) with a 1px dark eave shadow at row 27. style.evidence: The main materials use only 2-3 shading steps compared to 5-6 in the Beodeul references. The metal hood (rows 22-25) is an unshaded 28x4 flat fill of a single grey tone bordered by a stark near-black outline, the bricks are uniform flat-filled rectangles in a rigid grid, and the cooktop uses a mechanical 1x1 checkerboard dither rather than organic pixel clusters.
